svg.title: Поза голубя — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Yoga pigeon pose in a three-quarter view: front hip flexed and externally rotated, front knee bent with shin angled inward across the floor, back leg extended straight back with knee and instep on floor, pelvis square, torso upright supported by hands on floor at either side. Clearly distinguish forward bent knee and rear extended leg. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
